Spot-check against the Gallica image (https://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/btv1b9058938q/f100.item): f91r opens "Monsieur de Gondy", clear French with mixed letter/number cipher runs; his key image is the original Fr. 3995 f122v-123r table (A=7/1/9, B=6/9 ..., Monosillables, Nulles 17 22), and the cipher sign repertoire (digits, Greek-like letters, nulls) matches it; a full 10-symbol decode was not completed Verdict: partly confirmed.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): only George Lasry's report excerpt (lasry_entry.md) is in the repository; his full transcription and decryption are not, so they are recorded as missing (needs contributor: George Lasry).

George Lasry's permission of 24 Oct 2026 covers his decryptions on DECODE. Searched the full DECODE record list (10,606 records, fetched 24 Oct 2026 with the project cookie) for this shelfmark (Français 3622): no record, so DECODE holds no decryption of it; his full text exists only in his BnF cipher research report files. The excerpt state is kept.

George Lasry's report PDF (24 Oct 2026) received and extracted to lasry/report/ (summary, key image, excerpt and translation, full Readable text by folio); outcome.texts now points at his full text. Read share 0.903 (whole), 0.911 (deciphered passages); state read in part.
